available.quote: A person holding a license or certificate of registration to engage in the practice of engineering in another state, territory, or possession of the United States, the District of Columbia, or any foreign country may be issued a license in this state if the person applies in the manner required by the board, meets the qualifications provided in 37-67-323, and has passed the principles and practices of engineering examination.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a license or certificate of registration from another state/territory/DC/foreign country, apply as required by the board, meet qualifications of 37-67-323, and have passed the principles and practices of engineering examination. Applicants whose initial licensure does not meet experience requirements must demonstrate 2 years of postlicensure experience for each year of prelicensure deficiency.
requirements.quote: An applicant whose initial licensure in another state does not meet the experience requirements of 37-67-323 must be required to demonstrate 2 years of postlicensure experience for each year of prelicensure deficiency.

definition_quote.value: "Practice of engineering" means: (i) any service or creative work the adequate performance of which requires engineering education, training, and experience in the application of special knowledge of the mathematical, physical, and engineering sciences to the services or creative work as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning and design of engineering works and systems, planning the use of water, teaching of advanced engineering subjects, engineering surveys, and the inspection of construction for the purpose of ensuring compliance with drawings and specifications

engineer_intern_certificate_available.quote: "Engineer intern" means a person who complies with the requirements for education, experience, and character and has passed an examination in the fundamental engineering subjects, as provided in this chapter.

surveyor_in_training_certificate_availab.quote: "Land surveyor intern" means a person who has qualified for, taken, and passed an examination on the basic disciplines of land surveying, as provided in this chapter.

responsible_charge_defined.quote: "Responsible charge" means direct charge and control and personal supervision either of engineering work or of land surveying. Only a professional engineer or a professional land surveyor may legally assume responsible charge under this chapter.

seal_required_on_documents.quote: The licensee shall sign, date, and seal professional or technical documents created in the practice of professional engineering or professional land surveying.

seal_document_types.quote: The licensee shall sign, date, and seal professional or technical documents created in the practice of professional engineering or professional land surveying.

firm_practice_allowed.quote: A business entity registered with the Montana secretary of state: (a) shall obtain a certificate of authorization from the board before engaging in the practice of professional engineering or professional land surveying; and (b) may engage in the practice of professional engineering or professional land surveying in this state if at least one employee of the business entity is licensed by the board and identified as being in responsible charge

value: Practice of any other legally recognized professions or trades
Mere execution of work by a contractor, as distinguished from its planning or design or the supervision of the construction of work as a lead supervisor or superintendent

Work of an employee or subordinate of a person holding a license or practicing lawfully under this chapter, if the work does not include final engineering or land surveying designs or decisions and is done under direct supervision
Practice of professional engineering by licensed architects when purely incidental to their practice of architecture
exemptions_from_licensure.quote: The following are exempt from licensure under this chapter: (1) the practice of any other legally recognized professions or trades; (2) the mere execution of work by a contractor, as distinguished from its planning or design or the supervision of the construction of work as a lead supervisor or superintendent; (3) the work of an employee or a subordinate of a person holding a license under this chapter or an employee of a person practicing lawfully under this chapter if the work does not include final engineering or land surveying designs or decisions and is done under the direct supervision of a person holding a license under this chapter or a person practicing lawfully under this chapter; (4) the practice of professional engineering by licensed architects when the practice is purely incidental to their practice of architecture.
